hero.title: Mentors.
hero.subtitle: Learn from engineers working on real systems.

jose.bio1: I specialize in distributed systems architecture, building highly scalable bridges between hardware (IoT) and artificial intelligence to create efficient, interactive technology solutions for real-world problems.
jose.bio2Before: In the academy, my philosophy is simple:
jose.bio2Strong: get your hands dirty with real production code from day zero.
jose.bio2After: I will not teach algorithms you will never use or outdated tutorials; we build engineering pipelines and complete software repositories. I will teach you to model complex architectures, optimize client-side processing, and structure scalable logic for agents or pure web interfaces.
jose.researchSchool: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (西交利物浦大学)
jose.nexusDescription: Foundational academy platform and native interactive system.
jose.vlmDescription: Decentralized WebGPU inference engine with intelligent caching.
